title: Fast travel's 'known places' menu silently omits most rooms inside multi-room mazes (deep in Fenmarch's reeds, Cinderhall's downs, the barrow's own interior) even after repeated visits, with no explanation anywhere of what makes a place 'known' enough to jump to directly.
